correctness.rationale: An elementary up/down incidence commutator proves full rank of the adjacent Boolean-level inclusion map on both sides of half filling. Direct subset counting proves \(B^*B=kI+A_U\) and hence scalar energy -k on ker B. The Hilbert-Schmidt dissipation identity identifies the full fixed algebra after monitored-subgraph connectivity and cross-block conditions. A separate peripheral-spectrum argument rules out nonzero imaginary Liouvillian eigenvalues, and finite-dimensional Hilbert-Schmidt contractivity rules out Jordan growth. The conserved dark compression and trace determine the ordinary limiting density matrix. Transitivity yields the exact local return, and the central binomial difference is Catalan. The accompanying independently constructed finite matrices passed fifteen examples, including full small-Liouvillian multiplicity checks; finite tests are not a proof of the general identities.

originality.rationale: The inspected primary literature supplies Johnson quantum walks, known Johnson harmonic eigenspaces, and general Lindblad asymptotic theory, but not their specified combination for independent dephasing of every k-subset containing one fixed symbol. A highly relevant published Johnson-slice face-spectrum result instead concerns static concentration operators for functions of bounded Johnson degree. Generic Lindblad results give tools, not the stated Catalan dark-sector and local return expressions. Prior harmonic dimension and incidence rank are openly treated as known, not claimed new. Search noncoverage does not prove originality, and a hidden equivalent remains possible.
residual_risks: An unindexed or differently titled treatment may already combine one-coordinate Johnson monitoring with the same Catalan dark-space and return statements.

The published Johnson-slice face-concentration study was compared at summary level only; its static low-degree concentration statement does not directly imply the claimed Lindblad dynamics, but its complete appendices were not inspected.
The Kendon–Tregenna publication was available here at abstract level rather than full text; the abstract describes different discrete-time dynamics.
Known Johnson harmonic spectral dimensions are not original and should not be represented as novel in isolation.

value.rationale: The monitored set consists of a natural Johnson coordinate face, roughly one half of all vertices at central rank, and all individual monitoring rates may be arbitrary positive. The theorem exactly classifies retained quantum memory, including a nonzero-energy -k protected sector, and yields an unexpectedly sharp one-unit growth boundary: no memory at \(n=2k\), exponentially many Catalan coherent states and polynomial local return at \(\(n=2k\)+1\). This is an intrinsically motivated high-connectivity open-quantum-walk effect with exact observable consequences, not an arbitrary invariant or a mere finite calculation. It does not assert a uniform relaxation-time bound, laboratory realization, or many-body extension.
